verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a built-in AI assistant inside the Statsig console that users can hand tasks to. The AI-related capabilities shown are adjacent. The MCP server exposes Statsig to external clients such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code and ChatGPT, where the assistant lives in the third-party tool rather than in Statsig. AI Configs and evals are tools for experimenting on customers' own AI apps, not an in-product agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
